candidates.detail: RuntimeBody publicly exposes positions, normals, topology, rig state and a DeviceBody cache. Its validation checks lengths and related counts but does not associate the cached upload with those values. DeviceBody::get_or_upload returns its first cached GpuBody without invoking the supplied upload closure again. After one successful generic parametric armor upload, a Rust caller can modify the same RuntimeBody positions or other public fields while preserving the checked lengths and request another fit; the selected path can retain the old device buffers while the host Wearer borrows the changed body. The result depends on actual geometry, device and later consumers; no upload, mutation, fit or mismatch was executed.
candidates.consumer_and_safeguards: The generic parametric branch calls device_fit::fit_recipe_async using the body fit and realization, and Realization::upload delegates to the cache while Wearer borrows current host fields. Dedicated vambrace and breastplate paths use separate upload routes, so this is not a claim about every equipment type. The inspected tactical prepare_shape path clones the canonical body, calls BodyShapeKey::apply, which resets body.device even when weights are zero, then applies rig fitting before storing an Arc used for later generation. This establishes a bounded fresh-cache safeguard for that path; it does not establish every public caller, mutation, or cross-device reuse.
candidates.connected_scope: RuntimeBody mutable data and cache owner, Realization/FitBody relation, DeviceBody upload identity, generic parametric fit and readback, tactical body-shape and rig mutation order, selected consumers and device lifetime.
candidates.proposed_repair: After discovery and implementation authorization, establish one authoritative immutable body/device realization or ensure all source/device-affecting mutation invalidates or replaces its cached upload. Preserve the existing per-shape reuse and tactical reset, and investigate cross-device and concurrent ownership rather than assuming equal lengths imply identity.
candidates.later_acceptance: When product validation is authorized, demonstrate changed same-length body data cannot reuse the old device realization, unchanged bodies reuse correctly, tactical shape and rig changes remain correctly ordered, and any supported device-change or concurrent path honors its identity contract.
